mapper.select: SELECT P.idx AS "idx", P.sys_id AS "sysId", P.prd_cd AS "prdCd", P.prd_nm AS "prdNm", P.cte_idx AS "cteIdx", C.cte_nm AS "cteNm", P.prd_expl AS "prdExpl", P.use_yn AS "useYn" FROM TN_PRD_M001 P LEFT JOIN TN_PRD_CTE_M001 C ON P.cte_idx = C.idx WHERE P.sys_id = #{sysId} AND P.idx = #{idx} AND P.del_yn = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TN_PRD_M001 WHERE sys_id = #{sysId} AND prd_cd = #{prdCd}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TN_PRD_M001 (sys_id, prd_cd, prd_nm, cte_idx, prd_expl, img_file_grp_id, use_yn, del_yn, frst_rgstr_id, frst_reg_dt) VALUES (#{sysId}, #{prdCd}, #{prdNm}, #{cteIdx}, #{prdExpl}, #{imgFileGrpId}, #{useYn}, 'N', #{userId}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE TN_PRD_M001 SET prd_nm = #{prdNm}, cte_idx = #{cteIdx}, prd_expl = #{prdExpl}, use_yn = #{useYn}, last_mdfr_id = #{userId}, last_mdfcn_dt = NOW() WHERE idx = #{idx} AND sys_id = #{sysId}
UPDATE TN_PRD_M001 SET del_yn = 'Y' WHERE sys_id = #{sysId} AND idx = #{idx}
mapper.select: SELECT M.opt_grp_idx AS "optGrpIdx", G.opt_grp_nm AS "optGrpNm", M.sort_ord AS "sortOrd" FROM TN_PRD_OPT_MAP001 M JOIN TN_PRD_OPT_G001 G ON M.opt_grp_idx = G.idx WHERE M.prd_idx = #{prdIdx} ORDER BY M.sort_ord ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TN_PRD_OPT_MAP001 (prd_idx, opt_grp_idx, sort_ord) VALUES (#{prdIdx}, #{optGrpIdx}, #{sortOrd})
mapper.select: SELECT idx AS "idx", prd_idx AS "prdIdx", sku_cd AS "skuCd", price AS "price", discount_rate AS "discountRate", discount_price AS "discountPrice", barcode AS "barcode", use_yn AS "useYn" FROM TN_PRD_SKU_M001 WHERE prd_idx = #{prdIdx} AND del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY idx ASC

SELECT M.sku_idx AS "skuIdx", D.opt_val_nm AS "optValNm", G.opt_grp_nm AS "optGrpNm" FROM TN_PRD_SKU_OPT_MAP001 M JOIN TN_PRD_OPT_D001 D ON M.opt_val_idx = D.idx JOIN TN_PRD_OPT_G001 G ON D.opt_grp_idx = G.idx WHERE M.sku_idx IN #{skuIdx}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TN_PRD_SKU_M001 WHERE sku_cd = #{skuCd}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TN_PRD_SKU_M001 (prd_idx, sku_cd, price, discount_rate, discount_price, barcode, use_yn, del_yn, frst_rgstr_id, frst_reg_dt) VALUES (#{prdIdx}, #{skuCd}, #{price}, #{discountRate}, #{discountPrice}, #{barcode}, #{useYn}, 'N', #{userId}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE TN_PRD_SKU_M001 SET price = #{price}, discount_rate = #{discountRate}, discount_price = #{discountPrice}, barcode = #{barcode}, use_yn = #{useYn}, last_mdfr_id = #{userId}, last_mdfcn_dt = NOW() WHERE idx = #{idx}
mapper.select: SELECT K.idx AS "skuIdx", K.sku_cd AS "skuCd", L.idx AS "locIdx", L.loc_nm AS "locNm", COALESCE(M.cur_qty, 0) AS "curQty" FROM TN_PRD_SKU_M001 K CROSS JOIN TN_PRD_LOC_M001 L LEFT JOIN TN_PRD_STK_M001 M ON M.sku_idx = K.idx AND M.loc_idx = L.idx WHERE K.prd_idx = #{prdIdx} AND K.del_yn = 'N' AND L.sys_id = #{sysId} AND L.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY K.idx ASC, L.idx ASC

SELECT K.idx AS "skuIdx", K.sku_cd AS "skuCd", COALESCE(SUM(M.cur_qty), 0) AS "totalQty" FROM TN_PRD_SKU_M001 K LEFT JOIN TN_PRD_STK_M001 M ON M.sku_idx = K.idx WHERE K.prd_idx = #{prdIdx} AND K.del_yn = 'N' GROUP BY K.idx, K.sku_cd
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TN_PRD_STK_M001 (sku_idx, loc_idx, cur_qty, frst_rgstr_id, frst_reg_dt) VALUES (#{skuIdx}, #{locIdx}, #{qty}, #{userId}, NOW()) AS new_row ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE cur_qty = TN_PRD_STK_M001.cur_qty + new_row.cur_qty, last_mdfr_id = #{userId}, last_mdfcn_dt = NOW()

INSERT INTO TN_PRD_STK_H001 (sku_idx, loc_idx, move_type_cd, qty, sup_idx, unit_cost, mv_rsn, frst_rgstr_id, frst_reg_dt) VALUES (#{skuIdx}, #{locIdx}, #{moveTypeCd}, #{qty}, #{supIdx}, #{unitCost}, #{mvRsn}, #{userId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT H.idx AS "idx", H.sku_idx AS "skuIdx", K.sku_cd AS "skuCd", L.loc_nm AS "locNm", H.move_type_cd AS "moveTypeCd", H.qty AS "qty", S.sup_nm AS "supNm", H.unit_cost AS "unitCost", H.mv_rsn AS "mvRsn", H.frst_rgstr_id AS "frstRgstrId", H.frst_reg_dt AS "frstRegDt" FROM TN_PRD_STK_H001 H JOIN TN_PRD_SKU_M001 K ON H.sku_idx = K.idx JOIN TN_PRD_LOC_M001 L ON H.loc_idx = L.idx LEFT JOIN TN_PRD_SUP_M001 S ON H.sup_idx = S.idx WHERE K.prd_idx = #{prdIdx} ORDER BY H.frst_reg_dt DESC
